overview: This 460-page file documents Japan’s postwar financial reconstruction and the treatment of Japanese securities. It combines liquidation-agency stock-sale tables, SCAP securities controls, Dodge Mission budget and stabilization statements, yen devaluation debates, and extensive correspondence with foreign bondholders about defaults, repayment, and claims against vested assets.
interest: Bondholders’ personal appeals sit beside detailed stock-sale data and policy debates, revealing how occupation finance affected individual investors.
